title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You! — Episode3 Hello on the Slopes

meta.Event Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Line: Christmas Day
Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought you all did wonderfully in that rehearsal. I couldn't ask for any of you to be in better condition.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course we're in tip-top shape! It's been so long since Wonderlands×Showtime last put on a show together! It's only natural for us to be excited!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Performing on top of snow isn't easy...
But now that we've had a chance to do a full rehearsal and check over everything, all that's left is to give everyone a good show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm also gonna do my best☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How are you feeling, Robo-Nene? Good?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. My internal thermoregulation system is operating as expected.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thermoregulation system?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Sudden temperature fluctuations have made her prone to malfunctioning in the past, so I tried installing a new system in order to help mitigate that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, we're just about finished preparing for the show, so all that's left is to wait for the equipment we'll be using during the climax to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, we're free until the evening...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case, let's go skiing☆
I wanna go zoom-zoom-zoom down the mountain!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was just thinking the same thing, but I'd rather not risk any of us getting injured...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Instead, why don't we keep practicing for our show while playing in the snow?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Playing in the snow...? I have just the thing for that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This snowball maker.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, you made a Mr. Snowball Maker?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Our show this time around requires so many snowballs that we can't make them all by hand, so I decided to automate the process.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, while I make some final adjustments, why don't we make a snowman and have a snowball fight?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, both sound really fun!
Let's play, you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd rather not spend too much energy before the show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I guess I should be here for the final adjustments since it's me who's going to be using it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's take it for a spin.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All you have to do is place it on top of a nice mound of snow, press the button and...
se_event_specialpresent_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...! This is so cool!
It's spitting out so many snowballs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-At an incredible speed...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How are we even gonna use all these?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have a point... In that case, I can lower the speed at which it produces them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can adjust how fast it makes these...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, by using this lever.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is the middle setting, so if we lower it a little, then...
Huh? Kamishiro?
se_event_specialpresent_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I knew it... It's Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were wondering who was making all that noise. It was you guys...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Azusawa? Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh!
It's Kohane and her friends☆ Welcome to this wonderful ski resort♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Hi, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you all by chance here to see our show...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We are! And to go skiing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You won't believe how much Kohane's looking forward to seeing your guys' show. She couldn't stay still at all during the bus ride over.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But... I am really looking forward to your show! It's been so long since I last saw you all perform...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I'm wondering what sorts of effects you're going to use today...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Effects...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! Because I just love Wonderlands×Showtime's shows!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're always full of light, hope and excitement...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're so dreamlike.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Dreamlike, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
Then, I think you're going to love the climax of this show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?!
Hehe. I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We're blessed to have a fan such as yourself on our side. We really appreciate your support.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And she isn't alone.
The rest of us are also very much looking forward to your show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I've been meaning to ask...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What is that machine, and why is it producing snowballs at such a furious pace...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, you mean our snowball maker?
As you can probably tell, it's designed to make an infinite amount of snowballs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A character who specializes in snowball fights is going to appear in the show. So, we're going to need quite a few snowballs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A snowball fight specialist...
Oh, are you talking about the Phantom Snowman...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you know about him?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I remember seeing his name in the synopsis on the flyer Emu gave me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A snowball maker...? The Phantom Snowman...? What kind of show did you guys put together, exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm guessing most people would react the same way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There's no need to worry.
It's a fun Christmas show that's meant to make children smile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The story involves the strongest Santa Clauses from the land of Santas overcoming a series of trials in order to deliver their presents to the children waiting for them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The strongest Santa Clauses overcoming a series of trials...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In this world, there are quite a few enemies who wish to steal their presents.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to circumvent their attacks and get their presents to the children, they had no choice but to become stronger...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's the Phantom Snowman with his endless supply of snowballs, the Giant Gingerbread Man and some troublesome Christmas trees that are an absolute nuisance...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our Santas will battle against numerous enemies and even be betrayed by some of their friends as they attempt to reach their destination.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All in order to deliver the children their presents.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In summary, it's a perfectly standard tale about the Santa Clauses we're all used to seeing taking part in an epic struggle.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Perfectly standard...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm still trying to get my head around the idea of the bad guys trying to steal everyone's presents.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, the ones you just mentioned sound nuts.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's wonderful how the Santas keep fighting for the sake of the children...! I got so excited reading the synopsis on the flyer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure these Santa Clauses are going to put on a compelling performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I do like how these bad guys are going to stand in their way. It feels like a fresh and new idea...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but what exactly do you have to do to come up with this kind of story...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna know too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, Rui came up with this story himself.
What was your source of inspiration for it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The truth is, this story is based on something I experienced when I was little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When you were little...?
